notes.title: Update 4/17/2024
notes.content:
Fixed RB context popup not showing
Adds VR view (OpenXR) support

notes.title: Update 3/29/2024
notes.content: Fixes desktop (non VR) mode

notes.title: Update 2/26/2024
notes.content: Adds VR (OpenXR) support

notes.title: Update 12/13/2023
notes.content:
Reticle locking circle animation
Additional destruction VFX
Fixed guns temperature reported as heating up directly after initialization

notes.title: Update 12/12/2023
notes.content:
All structures are now free to build, but re-building is on a cooldown timer
AI will no longer build structures behind player position
Lowered projectile terrain repulsion strength

notes.title: Update 12/7/2023
notes.content:
Buggies are now capable of dashing as well
Walkers now use flamethrowers
Removed walker auto-approach and added a close combat button prompt
Guns will now temporarily shut down when overheating (instead of causing units to self-destruct)
Fixed objects dropped from destroyed units not correctly converting to collectable state

notes.title: Update 12/1/2023
notes.content:
Player controlled walkers will now auto-approach marked targets
Increased sniper fire repeat rate and live count
Added particle effect to silos
Newly build trucks now come carrying a power cell
Turrets now prioritize targets locked by the player
Flyers will now always dash when selected as unit type
Improved auto-build unit composition (outputs more balanced unit selection)
Fixed AI not building units when player is nearby AI base
Fixed base destruction VFX not spawning when still receiving damage
Increased time delay before guns overheat

notes.title: Update 11/28/2023 (2)
notes.content:
Restored missing beacons on mission 4 map
Fixed target locking health estimation always returning target as killed
Fixed AI unit mass scaling inversely scaling to player funds cap

notes.title: Update 11/28/2023
notes.content:
Increased turret projectile firing rate and live count
Fixed units incorrectly deciding to use travel booster
Altered mission 4 terrain
Fixed unit state being queried after out-of-bounds removal

notes.title: Update 11/27/2023
notes.content:
Added lock-on circle to reticle when holding fire trigger
Added hat factories
Flyers can now perform a dash
Enemy HUD locks scale with distance
Shortened duration of various particle effects
Fixed beams not properly reporting terrain intersections
Particle emitter stochastic alpha support
Fixed shared scan list generation being delayed by newly created units
Improved scan list generation performance
Turrets now launch missiles and have increased health
Turrets can no longer become incapacitated (their projectiles can)
Fixed powerups wanting to have their canister replaced befored being placed on node
Enemy lock camera tangent dot sort fix (would incorrectly prioritize off-screen targets)
Improved sniper fire accuracy
Increased missile visibility
Gun discharges now synced per weapon type
Limited number of live projectiles fired from a single vehicle
Adjusted structure auto-build behavior for Player and AI
Mission 1 nav map fix
Mission 3 added additional nodes
Player units no longer drop collectables
Fixed units being forced up when in a dense unit cluster

notes.title: Update 11/10/2023
notes.content:
Fixed booster light arcs
Altered mission 6 unit composition (2)

notes.title: Update 11/9/2023
notes.content:
Altered mission 2 terrain
Altered mission 6 unit composition
Increased sniper spawn rate

notes.title: Update 11/8/2023
notes.content:
Player units and structures are now build automatically
Removed all contextual sub-menus
Added sniper unit
Serializer can now restore to earlier save points
Guns can now overheat causing units to self-destruct
Cleaned up enemy unit/projectile locking/target selection
Altered mission 1 terrain
Each individual unit type now tracks their own hold-position
Made units orient toward their target
Fixed save hang bug when saving while delivering a powerup
Fixed unserialized vehicles moving through ground when saved while on production platform
Fixed particle-terrain collision fall throughs
Emitter projected motion vector normalization fix
Fixed looping emitters lifetime bug
Slowed down enemy projectiles
Vehicles now fire in rotary fashion (opposed to firing all at once)
Fixed enemy projectiles spawn by sentinels not being targetable
Fixed crash caused by drone trying to airlift unit that has already been destroyed

notes.title: Update 10/3/2023
notes.content: Frame graph construction performance improvement

notes.title: Update 10/2/2023
notes.content: LOD selection fix

notes.title: Update 9/30/2023
notes.content:
Command list population performance improvements
Frame time sampling fix
Shadow map terrain primitive culling improvements

notes.title: Update 9/22/2023
notes.content: Funds state fix

notes.title: Update 9/22/2023
notes.content:
Power canisters have sustained area of effect
Thrown power canister also affect projectiles
Enemy projectiles can be targeted by guns (player only)
Bases can now spawn an infinite amount of drones from surrounding vaults
Drones can no longer be targeted (only their cargo)
Bases now use canisters to visualize/restore health
Canister impact no longer disables player units
Booster targets are now fixed to a launch pad near the base and can launch omni-directionally
Boosters can quickly send newly created player/AI units to a forward position
Fixed player being able to reach and destroy enemy base in missions 3 and 5
Improved camera/vehicle/projectile target tracking
Removed lock on when firing weapons (player has to keep focus on enemy units when firing basic guns)
Added particle effect to beams that hit terrain (as opposed to hitting a unit)
Platform concurrent building fix (would only build one unit at a time)
Added a light to bugs to make them easier to spot
Added visualization for bug melee attacks
Simplified keycard collecting process in mission 3
Fixed not being able to build units when camera has focus on base
Fixed turret initial state (would face upward)
Drops (gears/canisters) out-of-bounds fix (would never expire)
Removed booster impact effect from previous update

notes.title: Update 8/23/2023
notes.content:
Grass instancing texture rnd fix
Boosted units incapacitate enemy units on impact
Turrets can now also be temporarily incapacitated
Removed vehicle death timeout/flashing
Added vehicle headlights
Optimizations to light culling
Fixed window draw update bug (2)

notes.title: Update 8/19/2023
notes.content:
Restored booster trigger icon
Fixed missing silo animation
Fixed window draw update bug

notes.title: Update 8/18/2023
notes.content:
Boosters are now used to launch units
Increased cost of boosters
Simplified Mission 4 terrain
Player and AI can now gather an infinite amount of funds, but the number of vehicles is capped
Player can now save anywhere (save terminals removed)
AI trucks no longer throw canisters
AI units (apart from silos) no longer collect gears
AI vehicle acceleration fix (would move at same velocity as player units)
AI silos picking up key cards fix
RT acceleration structure baking hard edge smoothing fix
Bug unit damage output fix
Improved camera tracking of off-ground and distant units
Simplified tutorial messages

notes.title: Update 8/4/2023
notes.content:
Increased camera dolly distance
Win10 staging resource fix
Boosted units incapacitate enemy units when colliding with them

notes.title: Update 7/31/2023
notes.content:
Scene snapshot state fix
Lowered terrain tessellation detail
Increased tutorial/message duration

notes.title: Update 7/30/2023
notes.content:
Updated Flyer and Buggy models
Vehicles use lights as health indicator
Improved terrain backface culling
Removes secondary page in unit build menu
Fixed crash caused by NaN in xfrm state

notes.title: Update 7/16/2023
notes.content:
Adds dynamic objects to ray tracing hierarchy.
Fixes RT TLAS not always building correctly.

notes.title: Update 7/14/2023
notes.content: Fixes crash on non-RT cards.

notes.title: Update 7/13/2023
notes.content:
Adds support for ray traced ambient specularity on metallic/water/snowy terrain surfaces
Improved terrain silhouette detail
Fixes terrain stitching UV warping bug
Fixes particle orientation bug on Nvidia hardware
Fixed rounding error in frame rate notation in settings menu
Fixed opening scene trying to query missing nav data
Fixed emissive animation texture offset bug
Fixed lava ball impact effect

Display cost in build menu
Scene unit serialization idle state fix
Fixed carts from not rendering

notes.title: 6/27/2023 Update
notes.content:
All unit types can now pick up gears
Gears no longer need to be delivered at a collector
Turrets properly aim at targets instead of being on a cycle animation
Nearby turrets can be controlled and will target the unit locked on by the player
Notion of depletable ammunition removed
Trucks replace floaters as unit that can pick up and throw power cannisters
Power cannisters can be used to restore structures' health
Added cannister splash particle effect
Unselected units now stay stationary
Lock on range for special weapons (missiles etc.) is now identical to main gun range
Main gun now also fires when there are no enemy units in range
Decreased main gun fire rate
Added RB context menu icon in bottom right corner
Updated foliage/tree models
Added animated fog
Improved light cluster and irradiance baker resolution
Improved terrain collision detail
